pretreatments.description: Mechanical shredding of olive pomace using a blender into small particles.

Ultrasonic pre-treatment of wastewater sludge using an ultrasonic homogeniser at a frequency of 20 kHz and 70% amplitude with a supplied power of 200 W for durations of 15 and 30 min (specific energies of 15,000 and 25,000 kJ/kg TS).
Microwave pre-treatment of wastewater sludge using a Microwave Digestion Unit for 30 min at a temperature of 175 °C and pressure of 2000 kPa.
